command:
sudo mkdir -p /etc/ssl/rotating /etc/nginx/scripts
sudo tee /etc/nginx/scripts/renew-cert.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
CERT_DIR=/etc/ssl/rotating
KEY=$CERT_DIR/tls.key
CRT=$CERT_DIR/tls.crt
TMP_KEY=$CERT_DIR/.tls.key.new
TMP_CRT=$CERT_DIR/.tls.crt.new

need_renew=1
if [ -f "$CRT" ]; then
  if openssl x509 -checkend 120 -noout -in "$CRT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
fi

openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout "$TMP_KEY" -out "$TMP_CRT" \
  -days 1 -subj "/CN=node1.local" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1.local,IP:$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')" \
  >/tmp/renew-cert.log 2>&1

mv "$TMP_KEY" "$KEY"
mv "$TMP_CRT" "$CRT"
chmod 600 "$KEY"

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
  nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
fi
EOF
sudo chmod 700 /etc/nginx/scripts/renew-cert.sh
echo DONE
